crossRefs.note: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
“Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”
But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
A man who is tormented by life blood will be a fugitive until death; no one will support him.
So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then the king’s wrath was pacified.
Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.
Yahweh has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands.
But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half…
saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”
He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary, and departed. He went away and hanged himself.

translations.web: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.
translations.bsb: But they lie in wait for their own blood; they ambush their own lives.
translations.kjv: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.
translations.asv: And these lay wait for their own blood; They lurk privily for their own lives.
